decisions.reason: Premium support sits close to the firm's core promise of agency-focused, round-the-clock expert help and costs little to sustain, so with turnover growing and slack available there is no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of these resources.

The version management tool builds on the firm's management-tool platform and reduces recurring operational work for customers, but it may later be folded into broader tooling, so moderate risk remains while it stays within aspirations.

The data processing contract generator is distant from the core and likely tied to the GDPR wave of 2018, so its value may be fading, but its running costs are low and slack lets the firm carry it a while longer.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship that embodies the firm's strategic direction, so management will keep investing in it rather than drop it.
